#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class C {
    istream ∈
    ostream &out;
    stringTokenizer st;
    bool eof;

    void submit() {
        nextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        out << fast(s) << "\n";
        // out << slow(s) << "\n"; // Uncomment to compare slow calculation if needed
    }

    static constexpr string BAD = "VK";

    string prepare(const string &s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb += c;
            } else {
                sb += 'A';
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slow(const string &s) {
        string ps = prepare(s);
        unordered_map<string, int> map;
        queue<string> que;
        que.push(ps);
        map[ps] = 0;

        while (!que.empty()) {
            string s_curr = que.front();
            que.pop();
            int curD = map[s_curr];
            if (s_curr.find_first_of(BAD) == string::npos) {
                return curD;
            }

            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < s_curr.size(); i++) {
                string nxt = swap_str(s_curr, i, i + 1);
                if (!nxt.empty() && map.find(nxt) == map.end()) {
                    map[nxt] = curD + 1;
                    que.push(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
        return -1; // theoretically should not reach here
    }

    string swap_str(const string &s, size_t i, size_t j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string buf = s;
        std::swap(buf[i], buf[j]);
        return buf;
    }

    static constexpr int INF = 1000000;
    static constexpr int MAX_N = 20; // safe upper for length

    string genStr() {
        int n = rand() % 15 + 1;
        static const std::string STR = "VKA";
        std::string buf(n, ' ');
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = STR[rand() % 3];
        }
        return buf;
    }

    int fast(const string &s) {
        string s_pre = prepare(s);
        int n = (int)s_pre.size();
        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3, vector<vector<int>>(0));
        // We'll store cntHere as vector for easier copying correspondingly

        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

        static const string STR = "VKA";

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int ch_idx = STR.find(s_pre[i]);
            a[i] = ch_idx;
            if (pos[ch_idx].size() <= sz[ch_idx]) {
                pos[ch_idx].resize(sz[ch_idx] + 1);
            }
            if (cntHere[ch_idx].size() <= sz[ch_idx]) {
                cntHere[ch_idx].resize(sz[ch_idx] + 1, vector<int>(3,0));
            }

            if (sz[ch_idx] >= 0) {
                if (sz[ch_idx] > 0)
                    cntHere[ch_idx][sz[ch_idx]] = cntHere[ch_idx][sz[ch_idx] - 1];
            }
            pos[ch_idx][sz[ch_idx]] = i;
            sz[ch_idx]++;
            for (int c=0; c<3; c++) {
                if (pref[i][c] >= 0) pref[i+1][c] = pref[i][c];
            }
            pref[i+1][ch_idx]++;
        }

        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(
            sz[0] + 1, vector<vector<int>>(
                sz[1] + 1, vector<int>(sz[2] + 1, INF)
            )
        ));

        int ans = INF;
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

        for (int j0=0; j0<=sz[0]; j0++) {
            for (int j1=0; j1<=sz[1]; j1++) {
                for (int j2=0; j2<=sz[2]; j2++) {
                    for (int last=0; last<2; last++) {
                        int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (curVal == INF) continue;
                        if (idx == n) {
                            ans = std::min(ans, curVal);
                            continue;
                        }
                        // Next choices
                        if (j0 < sz[0]) {
                            int cost = std::max(j1 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 0, j0, 1), 0)
                                     + std::max(j2 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 0, j0, 2), 0);
                            dp[1][j0+1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0+1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sz[1] && last == 0) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 1, j1, 0), 0)
                                     + std::max(j2 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 1, j1, 2), 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1+1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1+1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sz[2]) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 2, j2, 0), 0)
                                     + std::max(j1 - get_cntHere(cntHere, 2, j2, 1), 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2+1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2+1], curVal + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    int get_cntHere(const vector<vector<vector<int>>> &cntHere, int c, int index, int c2) {
        if (index == 0) return 0;
        // Count of c2 in first index elements of c
        if (cntHere[c].size() <= index) return 0;
        return cntHere[c][index][c2];
    }

public:
    C(istream &in_stream=cin, ostream &out_stream=cout) : in(in_stream), out(out_stream) {
        submit();
        // stress(); // Uncomment to run stress-test
    }

};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    C c;
}
